proposed_scenarios.description: Complete successful authentication workflow for OrangeHRM demo site using valid credentials, covering navigation from initial page load through form submission to authenticated dashboard state
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify that registered users can successfully authenticate with valid credentials and gain access to the OrangeHRM dashboard
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a registered OrangeHRM user, I want to log in with my username and password so that I can access the HR management system and perform my daily tasks

detailed_steps.description: Navigate to OrangeHRM dashboard URL which auto-redirects to login page
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page successfully redirects from dashboard URL to login page at /auth/login
detailed_steps.business_impact: User is directed to authentication interface when accessing protected resources

detailed_steps.description: Enter valid username into the Username field on login form
detailed_steps.business_impact: User can input their registered username for authentication

detailed_steps.description: Enter valid password into the Password field on login form
detailed_steps.business_impact: User can securely input their password for credential verification

detailed_steps.description: Click the Login button to submit authentication credentials
detailed_steps.business_impact: User initiates authentication process by submitting login form

detailed_steps.description: Verify successful authentication and navigation to authenticated dashboard
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page URL changes from /auth/login to /dashboard/index indicating successful authentication
detailed_steps.business_impact: User successfully authenticates and gains access to the protected OrangeHRM dashboard

detailed_steps.description: Verify authenticated dashboard state and user session establishment
detailed_steps.verification_point: Dashboard page loads completely with authenticated user context and navigation elements visible
detailed_steps.business_impact: User session is properly established with full access to HR management features

expected_results: User successfully navigates from initial URL to login page via automatic redirect
Username and password fields accept valid credential input without errors
Login button submission processes authentication successfully
Page navigates from /auth/login to /dashboard/index after successful authentication
Authenticated session is established with user logged into OrangeHRM dashboard
No authentication errors or security warnings are displayed during the workflow
edge_cases_to_test: Login behavior with slow network conditions during form submission
Session handling when user navigates back to login page after successful authentication
Form validation behavior if user clicks login button with empty fields
System response to multiple rapid login button clicks
Browser behavior when user opens dashboard URL in new tab while already authenticated
data_requirements: Valid OrangeHRM demo credentials (Username: Admin, Password: admin123)
Stable network connection for authentication request processing
Browser with JavaScript enabled for form handling and redirects
Session storage capability for authentication token management
prerequisites: OrangeHRM demo site is accessible at opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com
Login authentication service is operational and responding
Test credentials (Admin/admin123) are active and valid
Browser can handle HTTPS connections and form submissions
No existing authenticated session that would bypass login flow
